artboards.title: Direction C — What the parent sees

annotations.text:
The page.

The hero is the product running, not a picture of it — tap two numbers and the maths moves. Everything else is subordinate to that one interaction.

The competitor named is Zoom, because that is the truth.

Phone view is designed, not reflowed — three tiles stay on one row, because that row is the idea.

Below it: two other directions, kept rough on purpose. Each says why it might win and what it costs. Pick one and I will build it properly.
